author: EmuCore - Hub
title: PCSX2 1.7 BEST SETTINGS Dragon Ball Z Budokai Tenkaichi 4 (OUTLINE FIX + GHOSTING FIX)
summary: HarperMeows isolates outline and ghosting defects in the Team BT4 Dragon Ball Z modification under PCSX2 1.7, providing a short per-game correction rather than applying the same graphics preset to unrelated PS2 software.

blocks.text: The five-minute guide has a sharply bounded visual target: character outlines and residual ghost images in Budokai Tenkaichi 4, a community project built from an existing PS2 title. Separate links lead to PCSX2’s own distribution and Team BT4’s project page, allowing viewers to distinguish emulator provenance from modification provenance. A dedicated test is appropriate because widescreen behavior, post-processing and patches can interact differently in a fan revision than in the unmodified retail game.

The description does not state game CRC, Team BT4 release, renderer, internal resolution, PCSX2 commit, regional base or each changed option. A fix that removes an unwanted trail may also disable intended effects or fail after the modification updates. Obtain the mod only under its authors’ terms and use a lawful personal base game. Save the adjustment in a title-specific profile, compare motion and static scenes, and return to current defaults before blaming PCSX2. This video resolves one documented presentation problem, not global emulator tuning.
